= verbatim-footnotes(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-09-28
:manmanual: Footnote tests
:mansource: acdc

== Name

verbatim-footnotes - render enabled footnotes in code

== Description

Before footnote:shared[Shared note.]

[subs=+macros]
----
Listing footnote:listing[Listing note.]
Reuse footnote:listing[] and footnote:shared[]
Identical footnote:listing[Listing note.]
Repeated footnote:listing[Ignored listing replacement.]
----

[subs=+macros]
....
  Literal footnote:[Literal block note.]
....

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
let x = 1; footnote:code[Code note with *bold*.]
Repeated footnote:code[Ignored code replacement.]
Adjacent footnote:[Adjacent one.]footnote:[Adjacent two.]
Escaped \footnote:[Literal [brackets]]
----

[source,subs=+macros]
Styled footnote:[Styled source note.]

[literal,subs=+macros]
Styled literal footnote:[Styled literal note.]

[subs=+macros]
 Indented footnote:[Indented note.]

[source,subs=+macros]
----
footnote:only[Only note.]
----

[source,rust,linenums,subs=+macros]
----
footnote:only[]
footnote:[Last line note.]
----

[source,rust]
----
footnote:[Disabled note.]
----

[subs="+macros,-macros"]
....
footnote:[Explicitly disabled note.]
....

After footnote:code[] and footnote:[Final note.]
